maintenance.note: Planned work: covered nodes enter the maintenance state, raise no alerts, and are excluded from SLA. To silence notifications only (state and SLA unchanged), use <mutesLink>Mutes</mutesLink>.
maintenance.unavailable: Maintenance management is unavailable in skeleton mode.

empty.title: No maintenance windows
empty.sub: Schedule planned work so covered nodes raise no alerts.

delete.title: Delete maintenance window
delete.confirm: Delete maintenance window {{name}}? This cannot be undone.

maintenanceForm.title: Add maintenance window
maintenanceForm.name: Name
maintenanceForm.groupHint: Covers the group and all its subgroups.
maintenanceForm.tzHint: “From”/“To” are in {{tz}} (your browser’s local time) and are stored as UTC.

mutes.note: Silence notifications for a node (or one check) until a time — the alert still fires and node state / SLA are unaffected. For planned work, use <maintenanceLink>Maintenance windows</maintenanceLink>.
mutes.unavailable: Mute management is unavailable in skeleton mode.

empty.title: No active mutes
empty.sub: Silence a node (or one check) until a time to suppress its notifications.

lift.title: Lift mute
lift.confirmMetric: Lift the mute on {{target}} ({{metric}})? Notifications resume immediately.
lift.confirmAll: Lift the mute on {{target}} (all metrics)? Notifications resume immediately.

muteForm.title: Add mute
muteForm.groupHint: Silences every node under the group and its subgroups.
muteForm.tzHint: In {{tz}} (your browser’s local time) and stored as UTC.
